task.name: Strike_camp_shower_and_sink
task.when: During Strike after campers stop using the shower and sink

resources.resource: Water Lead, Power Lead, and Build Lead

step.action: Close the shower and sink to users.
Have the Water Lead isolate the potable-water supply.
Have the Water Lead move remaining line water into an approved fresh-water or gray-water container.
Run 🔧 Gray-Water_Pump until the shower, sink, and connected gray-water lines are empty.
Have the Power Lead de-energize and disconnect the gray-water pump.
Disconnect and cap each water and gray-water line in the printed order.
Clean and dry the shower, sink, pump, and hoses.
Dismantle the shower and sink in the printed reverse sequence.
Put every fastener and small part in its assigned hardware bin.
Pack each dry component and capped hose in its assigned transport group.

passWhen.criterion: No fresh water or gray water was released onto the playa.
The pump is de-energized and disconnected.
Every shower, sink, pump, hose, fastener, and small part is clean, dry, accounted for, and packed.
The former shower and sink footprints are clear and MOOP-free.
